info.title: Tolo marketplace API
info.description: Customer, merchant and admin APIs of the Tolo marketplace. JSON is snake_case; errors are RFC 7807 problem details with a stable `code` and a `correlation_id`.

post.summary: Exchanges the one-time code from the Tolo app for a session token

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text over the shop's name, description and city (typos forgiven).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only shops in this category.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only shops in this city.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default when q is set), newest (default otherwise), name, rating.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Only these items, as ids separated by commas (at most 50). Items that are not publicly visible are left out, and the rest come back in the order given unless q or sort is set.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. A smaller number means 1.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Items per page, 1 to 100. Zero or less means 20; more than 100 means 100.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The shop's id (uuid) or its slug.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: The shop to report on. Needed when the caller has more than one shop.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the report window, inclusive (ISO 8601). Default: 30 days before the end.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the report window, exclusive (ISO 8601). Default: the end of today in Addis Ababa. A report covers at most 366 days.
